title: Viettel Cloud
overview: Cloud management console for provisioning and operating enterprise infrastructure resources.
challenge: Provide a unified management interface for cloud resources while supporting role-based access control and centralized authentication.
contributions: Developed cloud management interfaces for infrastructure resources.
Implemented project-level RBAC and SSO authentication.
Integrated infrastructure monitoring through Prometheus and Grafana.
Contributed to CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
